text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey... Onii-chan.
Will you pat Curren's head?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Heeey... Onee-chan.
Will you pat Curren's head?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Curren Chan's pleading request,
I decided to pat her on the head.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...When Mama did this for me before,
my headache went away..."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Onii-chan...
...just a little more, please.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Onee-chan...
...just a little more, please.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems Curren Chan
is suffering from a headache...
